Engineering the Arizona Standard

Arizona House of Film is a factory-certified installer of Lintec window films. In our desert climate, where surface temperatures can exceed 160°F, we choose Lintec for its industry-leading thermal stability and molecular-level UV inhibitors.

Whether you are targeting massive HVAC savings or protecting high-end interiors from solar degradation, Lintec provides the nanotechnology required for long-term performance in Phoenix and Scottsdale.

Performance Metrics

  • Heat RejectionHigh Performance IR Block
  • UV Protection99.9% Solar Blockade
  • TechnologyAdvanced Nanotechnology

Arizona Climate Application

Lintec safety and security films are specified for institutional and government applications requiring documented performance data. The Japanese manufacturing standard delivers consistent mil thickness and adhesion performance critical for high-specification security installs.
